skill.name: database-admin
skill.description: Expert database administrator guidance for cloud database operations, automation, reliability, security, and cost control.
skill.summary: Guides cloud database administration, reliability planning, automation, monitoring, and security reviews.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Database operations need reliable plans for performance, recovery, security, and cost control. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce DBA checklists, architectures, and runbooks.
actual_capabilities: Designs high availability and disaster recovery plans for cloud databases.
Creates database monitoring, alerting, backup, and maintenance checklists.
Reviews database security topics such as RBAC, encryption, auditing, and secret rotation.
Plans Infrastructure as Code and GitOps workflows for database provisioning and schema changes.
Suggests cost optimization approaches for storage, capacity, replicas, and multi-cloud placement.
Covers relational, NoSQL, NewSQL, time-series, graph, search, and warehouse platforms.
limitations: It provides guidance and plans, not direct access to live databases.
It cannot verify credentials, production settings, backups, or failover behavior by itself.
It does not replace environment-specific testing, compliance review, or DBA approval.
It needs clear requirements for workloads, uptime targets, regions, budget, and compliance scope.

use_cases.title: Plan a Resilient Database Architecture
use_cases.description: Create a deployment plan with replication, failover, backup, recovery, and monitoring requirements.

use_cases.title: Improve Operational Runbooks
use_cases.description: Build checklists for patching, backup testing, incident response, and routine maintenance.

use_cases.title: Review Database Security Controls
use_cases.description: Assess access control, encryption, audit logging, secret rotation, and compliance gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Create a DBA Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for structured database operations guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a database administration checklist for a cloud PostgreSQL service. Include backups, monitoring, access control, maintenance, and recovery testing.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Monitoring Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a database monitoring and alerting plan for a production MySQL workload. Include key metrics, thresholds, dashboards, and escalation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Disaster Recovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for availability and recovery planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a disaster recovery plan for a multi-region database system. Include RTO, RPO, replication strategy, failover procedure, backup validation, and rollback criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Migration Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for cross-platform database operations review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this database migration strategy for risk, downtime, rollback, security, performance, and validation gaps. Recommend improvements and a phased execution plan.

output_examples.input: Design a backup strategy for a production database.
output_examples.output: A structured backup plan with full, incremental, and point-in-time recovery guidance, validation steps, retention rules, and ownership notes.
A monitoring gap analysis covering latency, errors, connections, locks, replication lag, storage, backup status, and alert routing.
A security checklist covering roles, service accounts, encryption, audit trails, credential rotation, network access, and compliance evidence.

best_practices: Provide database engine, cloud provider, workload size, uptime target, and compliance requirements before asking for plans.
Ask for verification steps and rollback criteria for every operational change.
Validate generated runbooks in a staging environment before using them in production.
anti_patterns: Do not apply generated migration or failover steps directly to production without review.
Do not omit recovery targets, maintenance windows, data sensitivity, or ownership details.
Do not treat cost optimization advice as final without checking current provider pricing and contracts.

faq.question: Can this skill connect to my database?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, checklists, and plans. It does not connect to live systems.

faq.question: Which database platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers major relational, NoSQL, NewSQL, time-series, graph, search, cache, and warehouse platforms.

faq.question: Can it help with disaster recovery planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline replication, failover, backup testing, RTO, RPO, and recovery procedures.

faq.question: Does it support cloud database operations?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, and multi-cloud database operations topics.

faq.question: Can it replace a database administrator?
faq.answer: No. A qualified owner should review outputs and validate them against the real environment.

faq.question: Is this useful for compliance work?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare control checklists for audits, but it cannot certify compliance by itself.
